```{r Load packages and config}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

source(here::here("analysis", "0-config.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "0-functions.R"))
```

```{r Load data}

df_all <- readRDS(here("data","grappe_mortality_data.rds"))
districts <- df_all %>% distinct(district) %>% pull(district)

niger_adm2_sub <- readRDS(here("data", "niger_adm2_sub.rds"))

dist_summ <- readRDS(here("data", "district_mortality_means.rds")) %>%
  filter(district %in% districts)

# Panels C and D
ate_preds <- readRDS(here("data", "preds_ATE.rds")) 

# Panel E
csi_preds <- readRDS(here("data", "csi_preds_mort.rds"))

# Panel F
post_prob_raw <- readRDS(here("data", "post_prob_dat.rds"))

```

```{r prep data}

# Panels A and B: District-level mortality rates in control arm and ATE estimates

niger_adm2_sub <- niger_adm2_sub %>%
  left_join(dist_summ, by = c("adm2_name" = "district"))

# Panel C: Mortality rate predictions from grappe-level spatial models

mod_mort_pred <- ate_preds %>%
    dplyr::filter(model == "gen_krig_int") %>%
    dplyr::select(geometry, predControl) %>%
    rename(pred = predControl)

mod_mort_pred_rast <- make_raster_map(mod_mort_pred, proj_crs, global_crs, "pred")
mod_mort_pred_df <- as.data.frame(mod_mort_pred_rast, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

# Panel D: ATE estimates from grappe-level spatial models

mod_ate_pred <- ate_preds %>%
    dplyr::filter(model == "gen_krig_int") %>%
    dplyr::select(geometry, ATE)

mod_ate_pred_rast <- make_raster_map(mod_ate_pred, proj_crs, global_crs, "ATE")
mod_ate_pred_df <- as.data.frame(mod_ate_pred_rast, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

# Panel E: Mortality rate predictions from CSI-level spatial models

mod_csi_mort_pred <- csi_preds %>%
    dplyr::filter(model == "gen_krig") %>%
    dplyr::select(geometry, pred)

mod_csi_mort_pred_rast <- make_raster_map(mod_csi_mort_pred, proj_crs, global_crs, "pred")
mod_csi_mort_pred_df <- as.data.frame(mod_csi_mort_pred_rast, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

# Panel F: Posterior probabilities of ATE < 0 from grappe-level spatial models

mod_post_prob <- post_prob_raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(model == "gen_krig_int") %>%
    dplyr::select(geometry, prob)

mod_post_prob_rast <- make_raster_map(mod_post_prob, proj_crs, global_crs, "prob")
mod_post_prob_df <- as.data.frame(mod_post_prob_rast, xy = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)

```

```{r base map}

base_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.25) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  annotation_scale() +
  scale_x_continuous(name = "Longitude") +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Latitude") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)
  )

```

```{r Panel A}

data_mort_control <- base_map +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, aes(fill = MortRateControl), color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 35),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,30,by=10),
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mortality rate\n(per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))

data_mort_control
```

```{r Panel B}

data_ate <- base_map +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, aes(fill = ATE), color = NA, size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = muted("dodgerblue"), 
                        mid = "white", 
                        high = muted("red"), 
                        midpoint = 0, 
                        limits = c(-13, 3),
                        na.value = NA,
                        breaks = seq(-10, 0, by = 5),
                        guide=guide_colorbar(title="ATE: difference in mortality\nrate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))

data_ate
```

```{r Panel C}

model_mort_control <- base_map +
  geom_raster(data = mod_mort_pred_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = pred), na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "grey60", size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 35),
                      na.value = NA,
                      breaks = seq(0,30,by=10),
                      guide=guide_colorbar(title="Modeled mortality rate\n(per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))

model_mort_control
```
```{r Panel D}

model_ate <- base_map +
    geom_raster(data = mod_ate_pred_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = ATE), na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "grey70", size = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = muted("dodgerblue"), 
                            mid = "white", 
                            high = muted("red"), 
                            midpoint = 0, 
                            limits = c(-13, 3),
                            na.value = NA,
                            breaks = seq(-10, 0, by = 5),
                            guide=guide_colorbar(title="Modeled ATE: difference in mortality\nrate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                            title.position = "top",
                                            title.hjust = 0.5,
                                            label.position = "bottom",
                                            label.hjust = 0.5,
                                            barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                            barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                            ticks.colour = "white",
                                            ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                            frame.colour = "white"))

model_ate
```

```{r Panel E}

csi_model_mort <- base_map +
    geom_raster(data = mod_csi_mort_pred_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = pred), na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "grey60", size = 0.25) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 35),
                        na.value = NA,
                        breaks = seq(0,30,by=10),
                        guide=guide_colorbar(title="Modeled mortality rate\n(per 1000 person-years)", 
                                            title.position = "top",
                                            title.hjust = 0.5,
                                            label.position = "bottom",
                                            label.hjust = 0.5,
                                            barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                            barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                            ticks.colour = "white",
                                            ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                            frame.colour = "white"))

csi_model_mort

```

```{r Panel F}

mod_post_prob_map <- base_map +
    geom_raster(data = mod_post_prob_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = prob), na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_sf(data = niger_adm2_sub, fill = NA, color = "grey55", size = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_c("grDevices::PinkYl",
                      limits = c(0.3, 1),
                      na.value = NA,
                      # breaks = seq(0,10,by=2),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(title="Simulated posterior probability\n(mortality ATE < 0)",  
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white"))

mod_post_prob_map

```


```{r composite figure}

fig2 <- data_mort_control + 
  model_mort_control + 
  csi_model_mort +
  data_ate +
  model_ate +
  mod_post_prob_map +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0.5, 0.7, 0.5, 0.7, "cm"))

ggsave(here("results", "manuscript", "fig2-primary_maps.png"),
       plot = fig2, bg = "white", width = 12, height = 11, dpi = 300)
 
```
